experiment: P10 online mixture over independent, persona-aligned and persona-inverse response models
scope: pure experiment only; no runtime controller, submission source or qualification change
case_status: all 18 cases were consumed previously; none is a new holdout

cases.legacy: the six SEED_SPECS families at repetition 1
cases.correlation_axis: four P9 resampled families at repetition 901 for centered_independent, negative_persona_aligned and positive_persona_inverse
cases.caveat: the existing aligned and inverse strata also use different public w transforms, so cross-stratum score differences do not isolate response correlation; comparisons between response estimators remain paired within each seed

latent_models.aligned: peace r ~ Uniform(1.05,1.5), violent r ~ Uniform(0.2,0.65), neutral r ~ Uniform(0.2,1.5)
latent_models.inverse: peace r ~ Uniform(0.2,0.65), violent r ~ Uniform(1.05,1.5), neutral r ~ Uniform(0.2,1.5)

likelihood_update: for each public uncapped first communication delta, infer r=delta/15 and add log(0.9*density_under_model + 0.1*density_under_independent); normalize with log-sum-exp
censoring: a first response ending on an opinion bound, or starting outside [-100,100], is recorded as censored and excluded from likelihood updates
prediction: an untried target uses 15 times the posterior-weighted conditional mean r and the published turn multiplier; a tried target always uses its own public first delta
initial_invariant: for peace, neutral and violent, the initial mixture mean r is exactly 0.85, hence first-slot delta 12.75, identical to the fixed prior
blackboard_boundary: posterior weights, likelihoods and censored observations remain in an experiment-local ledger; Blackboard receives only environment public facts
primary_contrasts: mixture versus fixed within each structure mode
mixture versus pooled within each structure mode
unrestricted versus full_gate within each response estimator
required_logs: ordered public actions, responses, budgets and action-log hash
posterior model weights before each action
accepted uncapped and ignored censored first observations
first action and candidate-set divergence for every paired contrast
final score, failures and resource counts
decision_rule: report all cases and strata; identify actual score/action changes; no production promotion from consumed development cases
